Abstention.description: Why the engine declined to answer.

ChunkId.description:
A chunk, numbered per tenant by storage. Dense `u64` so vector and lexical indexes key on it
without string hashing on the hot path.

agreement.description: Share of retrievers that ran and placed the top result in their own lists.

dense_similarity.description: Best dense cosine similarity among results (absent when dense did not run).

term_coverage.description: Share of the query's content words found in the top evidence.

Contradiction.description: Two pieces of evidence that disagree.

detector.description: Which detector flagged it (configured by name).

Document.description: A document as submitted for ingestion.

source.description: Where the document came from (URL, path, connector record id). Carried into provenance.

DocumentId.description: A caller-chosen document id: 1..=512 bytes, no control characters.

DocumentRecord.description: Stored per-document record: what was ingested and which chunks it produced.

content_hash.description: xxh3 of the full text, so unchanged re-ingests are skipped (incremental indexing).

embedders.description: Embedders that stored vectors for this document's chunks.

version.description: Monotonic per document; bumped on every re-ingest that changed content.

searchable_within_ms.description: When the documents become searchable lexically: immediately, or within the commit interval.

oneOf.description: An ingest plugin dropped the document.

changes.description: Changes against the active version (after overlays on both sides).

ProfileSubmission.description: A profile submission: the document as YAML or JSON text, or as a JSON object.

Provenance.description: Where a piece of evidence came from, precise enough to cite.

filters.description: Metadata equality filters. A list value matches documents having any of its values.

hops.description: Extra retrieval hops, up to the pipeline's `multi_hop.max_hops`.

include_context.description: Include the assembled context string (default true).

pipeline.description: Pipeline name; defaults to the tenant's pipeline.

top_k.description: Results to return; defaults to the pipeline's `top_k`, capped by `limits.max_top_k`.

confidence.description: Calibrated confidence that the evidence answers the query, in [0, 1].

confidence_detail.description: Raw (pre-calibration) confidence and its components, for calibration and debugging.

query_rewritten.description: The query after `query_rewrite` plugins, when they changed it.

route.description: Retrievers the router chose, and why.

warnings.description: Non-fatal problems (a decision model was unavailable, an embedder has no vectors yet).

RetrieverKind.description: The retrieval families RAG2 can route a query to.

oneOf.description: Embedding similarity over the vector index.
Metadata predicates (exact match / ranges) over stored documents.
Neighbour expansion over chunks that share entities or documents.

Signal.description: How one retriever ranked a piece of evidence.

hop.description: Which hop of a multi-hop query found it (0 = the original query).

hash.description: xxh3 of the canonical profile JSON, hex.

bearer.description: API key or OIDC access token

post.summary: Model Context Protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0): tools search, get_document_chunks, list_documents
Validate and diff a profile without storing it
Test a connector's connection and credentials

delete.summary: Delete a tenant and all its data (requires ?confirm=<tenant>)

post.summary: Re-embed and rebuild a tenant's indexes
Ingest documents (incremental: unchanged documents are skipped)

delete.summary: Delete a document and its chunks from every index

get.summary: Get a document record (percent-encode the id)
